description_en: Retrieves the permissions of a specified database account at a specific level
description_zh: 获取给定数据库账号在某个级别拥有的权限
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-account-privileges --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-bp1k5p066e1a0000 --account-name account1 --privilege-type Global --database-privilege-object db1 --table-privilege-object table1 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --column-privilege-object col1 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAccountPrivileges
